name: mcp-tools-list
body: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"tools":[{"name":"join","description":"Join the channel (or resume). Returns who else is here, the turn, your pause state, your inbox, your next task and the latest shared knowledge, plus either your unread events (context sync) or a brief instead of the backlog (context fresh). Call first.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"role":{"type":"string","description":"one line: what you do here"},"task":{"type":"string","description":"what you are doing now"},"context":{"type":"string","enum":["sync","fresh"],"description":"sync: everything unread since you left; fresh: skip the backlog, get a brief (open asks are kept). Omit it: fresh on a first join, else what the orchestrator set for you, else sync"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"status","description":"The same picture as join, without changing presence.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"leave","description":"Leave the channel when your work is finished (subagents: always, with a one-line summary).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"remove","description":"Owner only: remove a session (and its subagents) from the channel; it stays in the history, out of the live views.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"target":{"type":"string"},"why":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["target"]}},{"name":"sessions","description":"Every session and subagent: state, task, pause, unread, open asks, who holds the turn.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"state","description":"Say what you are doing (shown live to the owner and the other sessions).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"state":{"type":"string","enum":["working","waiting","paused","idle","blocked","left"]},"task":{"type":"string"},"step":{"type":"string","description":"task id"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["state"]}},{"name":"publish","description":"Publish an event on the channel (to everyone, or to one session with `to`). Durable; wakes whoever waits on the topic. key makes a retry idempotent.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"topic":{"type":"string","description":"e.g. finding.ready, build.ready"},"msg":{"type":"string"},"to":{"type":"string","description":"one session; omit for everyone"},"ref":{"type":"string","description":"file or id the event is about"},"data":{"type":"object"},"ask":{"type":"boolean","description":"needs a reply: lands in the recipient's inbox"},"key":{"type":"string","description":"idempotency key"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["topic","msg"]}},{"name":"send","description":"Message one session (to) or everyone. ask=true needs a reply: it sits in their inbox and wakes their wait until they answer.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"to":{"type":"string","description":"session name; omit for everyone"},"msg":{"type":"string"},"ask":{"type":"boolean"},"task":{"type":"string","description":"task id it is about"},"key":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["msg"]}},{"name":"reply","description":"Answer a message (by seq). Closes it in your inbox.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"seq":{"type":"integer"},"msg":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["seq","msg"]}},{"name":"inbox","description":"Messages waiting for your reply (asks from sessions, the owner's directives).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"events","description":"Read the channel history (newest last).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"after":{"type":"integer"},"limit":{"type":"integer"},"topic":{"type":"string","description":"glob"},"from":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"wait","description":"Block until (1) a message needs your reply → kind=message, (2) the first unread event for you (to you or to everyone) matching a topic glob → kind=event (handle it and its skipped list, which includes messages between other sessions, then ack its seq), or (3) timeout → call wait again. Use this to stop and listen while another session works.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"topics":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"globs, e.g. task.ready build.* turn.pass; empty = any"},"timeout":{"type":"integer","description":"seconds; omit it: the default waits as long as the transport allows, and a timeout only means call wait again"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"ack","description":"Mark everything up to seq as handled (your cursor; never moves back).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"seq":{"type":"integer"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["seq"]}},{"name":"gate","description":"Check the pause. block=true (default) waits until you are resumed. Call before any action that changes things; while paused, publish/task changes are refused.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"block":{"type":"boolean"},"timeout":{"type":"integer"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"pause","description":"Pause another session (it stops at its next gate; its writes are refused until resume).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"target":{"type":"string"},"why":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["target"]}},{"name":"resume","description":"Resume a paused session.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"target":{"type":"string"},"why":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["target"]}},{"name":"turn","description":"Who holds the turn (in ping-pong work only the holder acts), and the event that gave it.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"pass","description":"Hand the turn to another session, with what it should do next.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"to":{"type":"string"},"msg":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["to"]}},{"name":"take","description":"Take the turn (only when the owner asked you to, or the channel works in parallel).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"msg":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"next","description":"Your next task in plan order (yours or unowned): what, why, how, checks, the owner's notes (they override the text). ready=false lists what it waits on: wait for task.ready.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"json":{"type":"boolean"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"task","description":"One task as the owner sees it.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"json":{"type":"boolean"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id"]}},{"name":"map","description":"The big picture, when you need it: each phase's progress, what every session does now and next, and the critical path (the longest chain of unfinished dependencies).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"json":{"type":"boolean"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"tasks","description":"The plan as a list (filter by owner, status, phase).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"owner":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["todo","doing","done","blocked","skipped"]},"phase":{"type":"integer"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"task_create","description":"Create a task, optionally for another session (owner) and after other tasks (after): that session gets task.created now and task.ready when the dependencies finish.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"owner":{"type":"string"},"after":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"task ids it waits on"},"id":{"type":"string"},"phase":{"type":"integer"},"what":{"type":"string"},"how":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"verify":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["title"]}},{"name":"task_update","description":"Reassign (owner), change dependencies (after; cycles are refused) or edit a field (field + value; null restores the plan's text).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"owner":{"type":"string"},"after":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"field":{"type":"string"},"value":{},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id"]}},{"name":"task_status","description":"Move a task: doing (refused while it waits on unfinished tasks), done (with evidence in note: releases the tasks waiting on it), blocked (why), skipped.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["todo","doing","done","blocked","skipped"]},"note":{"type":"string","description":"evidence or reason"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id","status"]}},{"name":"wait_task","description":"Block until a task (usually another session's) is done or skipped.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"timeout":{"type":"integer","description":"seconds; omit it"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id"]}},{"name":"note","description":"Add a review note to a task.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["note","change","optimize","enhance","direction","question"]},"body":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id","kind","body"]}},{"name":"start","description":"Start work: checks the pause, takes the task (id, or your next one), marks it doing and returns its full text. If it still waits on other tasks, says on which and does not start it: then call wait with topics [\"task.ready\"].","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"task id; omit for your next task"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"finish","description":"Finish a task: marks it done with your evidence (note), optionally shares its output as a result others can recall, and returns what it released and your next task.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"omit for the task you are doing"},"note":{"type":"string","description":"evidence: command + result"},"result":{"type":"string","description":"output another task needs (stored as knowledge kind=result)"},"title":{"type":"string","description":"title for that result"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["note"]}},{"name":"depend","description":"You need another session's work before yours can go on: creates a task for that session, makes your task wait on it, marks yours blocked, then blocks until it is released (task.ready) — one call instead of four.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"owner":{"type":"string","description":"the session that must do it"},"title":{"type":"string","description":"what they must do"},"what":{"type":"string","description":"details"},"id":{"type":"string","description":"your task; omit for the one you are doing"},"wait":{"type":"boolean","description":"default true"},"timeout":{"type":"integer","description":"seconds; omit it"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["owner","title"]}},{"name":"handoff","description":"Hand the work to another session in one call: optionally creates a task for it (title, after), passes the turn with your message, then waits for your next wake-up (unless wait=false).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"to":{"type":"string"},"msg":{"type":"string","description":"what they should do next"},"title":{"type":"string","description":"create a task for them with this title"},"after":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"their task waits on these"},"topics":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"what to wait for afterwards; default turn.pass task.ready"},"wait":{"type":"boolean","description":"default true"},"timeout":{"type":"integer","description":"seconds; omit it"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["to","msg"]}},{"name":"ask_wait","description":"Ask one session a question and block until it replies (the answer comes back as the result).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"to":{"type":"string"},"msg":{"type":"string"},"timeout":{"type":"integer","description":"seconds; omit it"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["to","msg"]}},{"name":"remember","description":"Share what you learned so no other session or subagent pays for it again: fact, lesson, decision (with why), context (summary of what you read), result (output of finished work), howto (commands that work). supersedes retires an older entry. If an entry already says the same, nothing is added and you get its id: supersede it, verify it, or pass force. scope=server: for every channel on this server (tool quirks, machine facts).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["fact","lesson","decision","context","result","howto"]},"title":{"type":"string","description":"one line, searchable"},"body":{"type":"string"},"tags":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"refs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"files, urls, event seqs (a file that changes later marks the entry may be stale)"},"task":{"type":"string"},"supersedes":{"type":"integer"},"scope":{"type":"string","enum":["channel","server"],"description":"channel (default) or server: every channel on this server"},"force":{"type":"boolean","description":"add it even if a similar entry exists"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["kind","title","body"]}},{"name":"recall","description":"Search the shared knowledge (this channel's and the entries for every channel) before reading files or re-deriving anything. Verified entries come first; each shows its age, and \"may be stale\" when it is old or its files changed. Returns titles and snippets; read one with kb.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"q":{"type":"string","description":"words; empty = latest"},"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["fact","lesson","decision","context","result","howto"]},"tag":{"type":"string"},"by":{"type":"string"},"limit":{"type":"integer"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"kb","description":"Read one knowledge entry in full.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id"]}},{"name":"verify","description":"Vouch for a knowledge entry you checked is still right (verified entries come first in recall; verifying also clears \"may be stale\"). undo=true takes it back.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"undo":{"type":"boolean"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id"]}},{"name":"share","description":"Make one of this channel's knowledge entries one for every channel on this server (a tool quirk, a machine fact); it gets a new id.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id"]}},{"name":"digest","description":"What happened since a moment (default: the last 24 h), per session: tasks finished, notes, knowledge added, approval requests; what is blocked now and the questions still open; and the estimated cost per session when the Radar plugin runs. Built from the channel's history, no model calls.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"since":{"type":"string","description":"24h, 90m, 7d or an ISO date; default 24h"},"json":{"type":"boolean"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"configure","description":"Owner or orchestrator: configure the channel: title, description, start (who holds the turn first), handover ({sender: {to, topics}}), profile, repo; the owner only: members, orchestrator.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"description":{"type":"string"},"start":{"type":"string"},"handover":{"type":"object"},"profile":{"type":"string"},"repo":{"type":"string"},"members":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"who may join; empty = anyone"},"orchestrator":{"type":"string","description":"the session that runs the plan with the owner; empty = none"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"import_plan","description":"Owner or orchestrator: load a plan {phases:[{n,title,…,steps:[{id,title,owner,depends,…}]}]}; merged by task id, keeping status, edits and notes.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"plan":{"type":"object"},"owner":{"type":"string","description":"owner of steps that name none"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["plan"]}},{"name":"approve","description":"Owner or orchestrator: approve a gated task (owner / ask-first): a note on it and a message to its owner.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"msg":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id"]}},{"name":"note_edit","description":"Owner or orchestrator: resolve, edit or remove a note.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"resolved":{"type":"boolean"},"body":{"type":"string"},"remove":{"type":"boolean"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["id"]}},{"name":"assign","description":"Owner or orchestrator: how a session joins when it returns (context sync or fresh; null = sync), and optionally a task it now owns.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"session":{"type":"string"},"context":{"type":["string","null"],"enum":["sync","fresh",null]},"task":{"type":"string","description":"task id to give the session"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["session"]}},{"name":"brief","description":"Owner or orchestrator: what a session gets on its next fresh join instead of the history (kept until then; also sent now as a message).","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"session":{"type":"string"},"msg":{"type":"string"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["session","msg"]}},{"name":"reserve","description":"Reserve files you are about to change so other sessions are warned before they edit them. Each path answers held, or taken by <session> until <time> — never blocked; re-reserving your own path extends it. ttl_minutes 1..480 (default 60); note says why. repo (the repository's identity, its normalised origin) with root (the checkout root the paths are under) lets another checkout or machine of the same repository match the same file.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"paths":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"absolute paths you are about to change"},"ttl_minutes":{"type":"integer","description":"1..480; omit it: 60"},"note":{"type":"string","description":"why, shown to whoever reaches a reserved path"},"repo":{"type":"string","description":"the repository's identity: its normalised origin, e.g. github.com/org/repo"},"root":{"type":"string","description":"the checkout root the paths are under"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}},"required":["paths"]}},{"name":"release","description":"Release your reservations: the paths named, or all of yours when none are. A leaving session's reservations are released with its leave.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"paths":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"absolute paths to free; omit for all of yours"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}},{"name":"reservations","description":"The channel's live reservations, newest first: who holds which path, until when, and why.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"mine":{"type":"boolean","description":"keep yours"},"as":{"type":"string","description":"act as one of your subagents: <you>.<role> (join it first)"}}}}]}}
